6.355 rsAggregateInJoinExpression
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsAggregateInJoinExpression is a critical error that will occur when JoinCondition.ForeignKey or
JoinCondition.PrimaryKey contains a reference to an aggregate function (see section 2.341.7).
